description: Create report.html - the reports system with a new 'Qarzlar' (Debts) tab added alongside existing sales reports and inventory reports. This file provides admin-level analytics and debt management overview.
steps: Create /projects/sandbox/multi/report.html as a complete single-file HTML application with inline CSS and JavaScript

Include all existing functionality from the user-provided report.html structure: PIN login (admin only), tabs for 'Hisobot' (sales report by product), 'Zaxira' (inventory/stock report), and 'Admin' section
Include Firebase SDK from CDN and placeholder firebaseConfig (same structure as Market.html)
Add a new 'Qarzlar' tab in the navigation alongside existing tabs (Hisobot, Zaxira, Admin)

In the Qarzlar tab, show statistics cards at the top: Qarzdorlar soni (number of debtors), Ochiq qarzlar summasi (total open debts amount), To'langan qarzlar (paid debts total), Qarzga sotilgan savdolar soni (number of credit sales)
Add filter controls: All/Tashkilotlar/Shaxslar filter, Ochiq/To'langan/Barchasi status filter, Search input for name/organization

Display a table/card list of each debtor showing: name, organization (if applicable), login, phone, total debt amount (jami qarz), paid amount (to'langan), remaining amount (qolgan), number of purchases
For each debtor, allow expanding to see individual debt records (date, items, amount, payment status)
Add 'To'lash' (Pay) button for each debtor that opens a payment modal (same logic as in Market.html - distribute to oldest debts first)
Add ability to fully clear/delete a debt when it's paid (mark as paid, optionally remove)
Add CSV export functionality for the debts report
Ensure real-time Firebase listeners for all debt data
All UI text must be in Uzbek language
acceptance_criteria: File opens without JavaScript errors (valid HTML/JS syntax)
Contains Firebase SDK includes and placeholder config
Shows debt statistics (debtor count, open debts, paid debts, credit sales count)
Has filter controls for type, status, and search
Displays debtor list with debt details
Payment functionality works with FIFO distribution
CSV export works for debt data
verification: Check HTML contains Qarzlar tab and navigation element
Verify statistics section exists with appropriate IDs/classes
